resources.string: The shared Movies folder is not available on this device right now.
Recordings are saved on this device first and copied to Movies/Nuvio Recordings when they finish. Other apps, such as media players, can see them there.
Waiting to copy to the Movies folder
The recording will be removed from the list and from the Movies folder.
Removed from the list. The file in the Movies folder belongs to an earlier installation of this app, so it was kept. Delete it with a file manager.
